questions.q: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: 'Every citizen must abide ___ the law of the land.'

questions.q: Which preposition best completes the sentence? 'A loving mother is often blind ___ her child's faults.'
questions.e: blind to = (দোষ ইত্যাদি) দেখতে না পাওয়া; blind in one eye = এক চোখে অন্ধ।

questions.q: Select the right word for the gap: 'I congratulated her ___ her brilliant result.'

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: 'Water consists ___ hydrogen and oxygen.'
